properties.title: SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: Evaluation of a causal pose-controllable ultrasound world model on held-out EM-tracked thyroid scans, a held-out multi-organ clip set and a five-rater user study.
properties.independent_study_claim: single-group study; no external site or public benchmark

properties.description: Latent action model, Wan2.1 video diffusion transformer pretrained on unlabeled ultrasound, pose post-training on EM-tracked scans, and a causal self-forcing student with selective KV-cache eviction.

properties.algorithm: SonoWorld causal pose-controllable ultrasound video generator

properties.population: patients undergoing thyroid, cardiac or abdominal ultrasound (action grounding on thyroid only)
properties.decision: policy evaluation and exploratory action scoring in a simulated environment; no patient use

properties.description: Held-out EM-tracked thyroid scans from 9 validation subjects (33 subjects train)
500 held-out multi-organ clips (64 thyroid, 218 liver, 218 cardiac)
55 generated clips rated by five experienced ultrasound raters
Held-out tracked scans, held-out multi-organ clips and a small reader study; split unit for the multi-organ hold-out and use of the validation subjects for model selection are not stated

properties.algorithm: Causal model trained with teacher forcing
Causal model trained with diffusion forcing
Causal model trained with rolling forcing
Causal model trained with reward forcing

relation_assertions.rationale: An action-conditioned generator with an exploratory comparison of equal-magnitude opposite probe motions, with no identified effect claim and no learned policy. BP_CONTROLLER is not met because no policy optimization is reported.

capability_assessments.rationale: Generated continuations conditioned on metric 6-DoF probe motion are scored against measured continuations and tested under zero, doubled, reversed and single-axis actions, supporting L2 (V12, V13). L3 is not assigned because the equal-magnitude opposite-motion comparison scores rollouts against a goal frame rather than against real outcomes of the alternative action, rests on a small number of held-out scans, and is near or below chance for some axes (rotation z 44.4 percent at threshold 20). Core membership (V11) is met by a KV-cache state carried across blocks, a learned temporal model and a healthcare acquisition setting.

Core membership (V11) is met by a KV-cache state carried across blocks, a learned temporal model and a healthcare acquisition setting.

gate_assessments.rationale: Provenance is cohort-level, subject-level splits exist for tracked data, but the split unit of the multi-organ hold-out, the use of the validation subjects for reporting and overlap with natural-video pretraining are not addressed.
Generated continuations are scored against measured continuations on held-out tracked scans and across several action settings.
Eight-second rollouts are scored but no maximum supported horizon or horizon-error curve is given.
Actions are well specified and calibrated, but alternative-action evidence is a small exploratory discrimination test with some axes near chance.
A five-rater study of 55 clips has no comparator system and no agreement statistic.

legacy_cells.BS: Autoregressively generated future B-mode ultrasound video frames, decoded at 256 × 256 resolution.
legacy_cells.BT: No separate clinical readout head reported; the model directly generates future ultrasound observations.
legacy_cells.BU: For action discrimination, PSNR between each generated terminal observation and the target frame is used as the reward for ranking candidate probe motions.
legacy_cells.BV: Video diffusion flow-matching loss plus a motion-consistency loss (weight λ = 0.1); latent-action model training uses frame reconstruction loss plus a KL regularizer.
legacy_cells.EC: Target-directed probe motion ranked above equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials; action-discrimination evidence, not clinical benefit.
legacy_cells.EE: Five experienced ultrasound raters evaluated 55 generated clips for image quality, video consistency and probe–anatomy alignment; fixed-frame alternative paths and fixed-path shifted initial frames were assessed.

notes: Causal pose-controllable ultrasound video generator built from a latent-action pretrained Wan video diffusion model, post-trained on EM-tracked thyroid scans and distilled to a self-forcing causal student with selective KV-cache eviction.
